sloka: बुधस्य माधवो मासस्तामिलां रुचिराननाम् ।गतो रमयतो ऽत्यर्थं क्षणवत्तस्य कामिनः ।। ७.८९.८ ॥
transliteration: budhasya mādhavo māsastāmilāṁ rucirānanām ।gato ramayato 'tyarthaṁ kṣaṇavattasya kāminaḥ ।। 7.89.8 ॥

translations.english: For Budha, the lustful one, the month of Madhava passed like a moment while he was exceedingly enjoying with Tamila of the beautiful face.
